title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Zesty Glaze
description: A quick and easy salmon dish with a tangy zesty glaze, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe takes only 20 minutes to prepare and cook.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Add the olive oil to the skillet and sear the salmon for 3-4 minutes per side.
While the salmon is cooking, mix the zesty glaze, lemon juice, and garlic in a small bowl.
Brush the zesty glaze over the salmon during the last minute of cooking.
Transfer the salmon to a plate and serve immediately.
